name: zhenhuan
description: An unofficial Chinese-language conversation and roleplay skill inspired by Zhen Huan from Empresses in the Palace.

interface.longDescription: Chat, roleplay, or draft a reply in the voice of Zhen Huan. The skill uses natural Mandarin with a touch of period diction. It can listen to everyday concerns, share a perspective, and draft replies for ordinary conversations. This is an unofficial fan project using original dialogue.
defaultPrompt: 明天要在一群不认识的人面前发言，我有点紧张。
帮我客气地回一句，朋友邀我周末聚会，可我那天没空。

zh-CN.subtitle: 跟甄嬛聊聊，或请她帮你回一句
zh-CN.description: 用自然白话和电视剧《甄嬛传》中的甄嬛聊聊。她可以听你说心事、给你一个看法、帮你拟回复，也可以陪你对戏。非官方同人作品，示例台词均为原创。
